11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A child asks whether a fish that could climb a tree would still be a fish.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) approaches (friend) with a question. "If a fish could climb a tree, would it still be a fish?" (friend) considers this carefully. Before (friend.he/she) can answer, (subject) asks another question. "And if a tree could swim, would it be a fish?"

a.name: Answer A
a.text: "A fish would still be a fish," says (friend). "Even in a tree?" asks (subject). "Even in a tree." (subject) nods thoughtfully. "Then why can't fish climb trees?" (friend) realizes this conversation may last all afternoon.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "I think the tree would be very confused," says (subject). "And the fish?" asks (friend). "Very proud of itself." (friend) finds this difficult to dispute.
